info.title: API-DocTest-Replace Hotel Loyalty Points Transfer-v3-spec
info.description: The Hotel Loyalty Points Transfer API facilitates the seamless transfer of loyalty points between members within a hotel loyalty program. This enables members to share their points with friends or family, enhancing the overall customer experience. The API primarily handles operations related to point transfers, ensuring accuracy and security during the process. It is typically utilized by users managing their loyalty accounts, including frequent travelers and program administrators. This API expands the functionality of loyalty programs, making them more flexible and appealing to consumers.

put.description: This endpoint allows users to transfer points from their account to another user's account. Ensure that you have sufficient points for the transfer and provide the recipient's account information.

requestBody.description: Submit a request to transfer points from one account to another. The request must include the necessary details such as the source account, destination account, and the amount of points to transfer.

200.description: The points transfer request was completed successfully.
